Generate Zenodo metadata

Source: R/zenodo-functions.R
generate_zenodo_json.Rd

Generate a .zenodo.json file from either an R package DESCRIPTION file or a Citation File Format (CFF) file.

Usage

generate_zenodo_json(
  description_file = "DESCRIPTION",
  cff_file = "CITATION.cff",
  output_file = ".zenodo.json",
  from = c("description", "cff"),
  github_topics = TRUE
)

Arguments

description_file

Path to the DESCRIPTION file.

cff_file

Path to the CITATION.cff file.

output_file

Path to the generated Zenodo JSON file.

from

Source of metadata: either "description" or "cff".

github_topics

Logical; if TRUE, attempt to retrieve GitHub repository topics and add them as keywords.

Value

Invisibly returns the generated Zenodo metadata as a list.
